name: woodshed
description: A multiplayer workspace for participatory music communities.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @woodshed/web && node tools/verify-foundation.mjs && node tools/privacy/check-manifest.mjs
scripts.lint: node --check tools/privacy/scanner.mjs && node --check tools/privacy/scan.mjs && node --check tools/privacy/check-manifest.mjs && node --check tools/release/verify.mjs
scripts.test: node test/contracts/kernel.test.ts && node --test test/conformance/*.test.ts test/conformance/deployment/*.test.ts test/privacy/*.test.mjs test/snapshot/*.test.ts test/e2e/participant-choice/*.test.ts test/e2e/rehearsal/*.test.ts test/e2e/live/*.test.ts test/uat/*.test.ts && npm run test -w @woodshed/web -- --run
